interpretations.label: Nominal GDP
interpretations.description: Total economic output valued at current market prices in US Dollars
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Gross Domestic Product in current USD
caveats: Does not account for differences in local price levels

interpretations.label: GDP PPP
interpretations.description: Total economic output adjusted for differences in purchasing power parity across countries
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Gross Domestic Product based on purchasing power parity in international dollars
caveats: PPP estimates are model-dependent and subject to periodic baseline revisions

knownRisks: Historical data for certain economies may be incomplete or subject to retrospective revisions prior to 1980
Changes in national accounting standards over the multi-decade time span
